items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I'm the one who learned him.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I was trying to get his first name. Nobody hardly ever used it, but I didn't know it. His first name. It was a real old time. Did you? Some little Robertson. Did you get him? Robertson? Robertson piano. What's his first name? Samla. Samla? No. Samla. That's another old timer. What?
Your brother played? My brother played. Yeah, he's dead too.
